title: Thay Bain Sakina Ke Lo Jald Khabar Baba
body:
Lagta Hai Adhere Se,  Zindaan Mai Dar Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Kaan Mere Zakhmi Aur Khak Hai Baloon Par
Boseeda Mera Kurta Hai Khoon Mai Tar Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Behta Hai Lahu Ab Tak Zakhmi Mere Kaanoo Sai
Kheenchy Hai Sitamgar Ne Is Tarha Gohar Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai Shaam Kai Zindaan Mai Ghut Ghut Kai Na Mar Jaon
Ek  Pal Ko Nahi Khulta Zindaan Ka Dar Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Turbat  Pai Mere Baba Ek Shamma Jala Dena
Mai Apke Ane Tak Mar Jao Agar Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Baba Buhut Maine Tha Yaad Keya Tumko
Par Deekhne Baite Ko Aye Na Magyar Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Gar Milti Mujhy Muhlat To Jati Madiney Mai
Matam Mai Tera Karti Aur Roti Buhut Baba
